newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Central Bank ready to help Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Central Bank ready to help Thailand.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Thursday it was ready to help support the embattled Thai baht if Bangkok asks.
But no request has so far been made, Central Bank Treasurer Sergio Edeza told Reuters.
"If they do send in their request, we are bound to send them assistance," he said.
The Philippines was part of an agreement with other Asian monetary authorities in 1996 to help each other in case of speculation against their currencies.
The Thai baht had been under pressure due to concerns about the slowing Thai economy and rumours of political turmoil in the cabinet.
